description: Make a presentation in the user's PitchBoost account from a prompt: a lesson or lecture, a class or thesis presentation, a report or update, a talk or workshop, or a sales or investor pitch, in any language. Returns a shareable link. Generation takes up to ~60 seconds.

kind.description: Deck type. Defaults to pitch_deck, a slide presentation for any purpose.

prompt.description: What the presentation is about, who will see it, and what it should achieve. For a pitch, include the company, the offer and the prospect.

name: create_deck
